instagram_title: T-Shirt Pilling — Why There's Normally No Fix Once It Starts
youtube_description:
Pilling on t-shirts — those tiny balls of fibre on the fabric surface — comes from construction and mill processing: fibre type, yarn and fabric construction, and finishing all affect it. Once a garment starts pilling there is normally no fix, so control has to start at the specification stage, not after delivery. Agree a pilling performance level with your supplier in writing before you order.
